description: xrplFeeSponsoring joint test vectors — real XRPL Devnet blobs, validated on-ledger. Assert verbatim (hex, uppercase). Provenance: every vector is re-derivable from the public Devnet history via the `tx` method with binary:true.
source: Devnet run 2026-08-04 (wss://s.devnet.rippletest.net:51233, rippled 3.3.0-rc5, XLS-68 Sponsor amendment active). Evidence chain in whawk46/xls68-x402-fee-sponsoring.

vectors.name: sponsored-payment
vectors.summary: Payer rJ62o14Y… (1 drop XRP, fee-sponsored) pays merchant rBnfftQc… 2.5 FCD; facilitator rwun2DNk… carries the 12-drop fee via Sponsor + SponsorSignature. Both parties signed identical STX\0 bytes.
vectors.baseSchemeReason: carries `Sponsor` and `SponsorSignature`, which are not in the base scheme's Payment field allowlist

extensionAware.note: This blob is fully countersigned (SponsorSignature present), which is the settlement-layer artifact. The extension's /verify path expects SponsorSignature ABSENT in both modes — do not feed this blob to /verify and expect acceptance.

vectors.name: plain-payment
vectors.summary: Ordinary issued-currency Payment (issuer funds the payer with 10 FCD), no sponsorship fields anywhere.
vectors.baseSchemeReason: every field is in the base allowlist
vectors.scope: Byte-level claim: every field in the base allowlist and the Devnet signature verifies offline. Full base-scheme verification would stop at the IOU SendMax rule (no SendMax carried).

note: Per dimitricole (x402 #3048): the sponsored-payment vector also earns its keep in the base suite today as a must-reject fixture — rewrapped under base-scheme terms it must still be refused, and that refusal lands on the bytes themselves.
